about: An AI growing up: does an AI's idea of a chair change with more data and a bigger model? docs/plato_scale.md; plan docs/plato_scale_plan.md
credits: Human drawings: Google Quick, Draw! dataset (Google Creative Lab), CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/googlecreativelab/quickdraw-dataset (statistics only; no drawing is included)
Sketch model design after Sketch-RNN: Ha, D. & Eck, D. (2017), A Neural Representation of Sketch Drawings
Language models: Qwen2.5 and Qwen3 (Alibaba Cloud), OLMo 2 (Allen Institute for AI), Muse Glimmer 30B (Meta), all Apache-2.0; Muse Spark 1.3 and Muse Wonder 1.0 through the Meta Model API
Hypothesis tested: Huh, M., Cheung, B., Wang, T. & Isola, P. (2024), The Platonic Representation Hypothesis, ICML 2024, arXiv:2405.07987
prompt: Draw a simple chair as an SVG drawing: black strokes only on a white background, 256 by 256 pixels, no text, no colour fill. Output only the SVG code.

skipped.reason: Qwen licence (not Apache-2.0); too big for one card
